patches.name: Drawable clean
patches.description: Keeps drawable/mipmap resources only in the target density bucket and removes duplicate-named copies from every other density bucket, relying on Android's density fallback to resolve them.

patches.name: Hide ad layouts
patches.description: Zeroes size and hides visibility of ad-related view containers in layout XML.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Neuters ad-load entry points for major ad SDKs, poisons const-string ad network hosts/unit-id prefixes across all bytecode, and hides leftover ad view containers in layout XML.

patches.name: Remove analytics
patches.description: Neuters logging entry points for major analytics/crash-reporting SDKs, poisons const-string analytics hosts and component names across all bytecode, and strips Firebase receiver/service declarations from the manifest.

patches.name: Strip Firebase manifest components
patches.description: Removes Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics receiver and service declarations from AndroidManifest.xml.
